items.difficulty_reason: The property P(f) = 'f is pseudo-coherent' is fpqc local on the base. The retained proof is written against the same descending-criterion template as the perfect case (card L16092, collected): Zariski locality from the Definition (definition-pseudo-coherent), flat-base-change preservation from chapter lemma flat-base-change-pseudo-coherent, and the faithfully-flat descent hypothesis translated into the explicit algebra assertion that for A -> B faithfully flat and C = A[x_1,...,x_n]/I, pseudo-coherence of C tensor_A B over B[x] descends to pseudo-coherence of C over A[x] — identified as More on Algebra, lemma flat-descent-pseudo-coherent. Retained author proof at lines 17498-17515.
